---
title: "Prior predictive checks"
---

```{r}
#| output: false

library(bayesplot)
library(brms)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(targets)

color_scheme_set("viridis")

```


Below is the structure of the data frame used to perform prior predictive
checks:

```{r}
df <- tar_read(df_prior_checks)
str(df, give.attr = FALSE)
```

## Model 1A (dimensional approach): Association between early-life adversity predictors and behavioural outcomes

```{r}
prior_checks_1A <- tar_read(fit_prior_model1A)

mcmc_plot(prior_checks_1A, type = "dens", variable = c("b_Anxiety_Threat")) +
    labs(x = expression(beta[k]))

mcmc_plot(prior_checks_1A, type = "dens", variable = c("b_Depression_Threat")) +
    labs(x = expression(beta[k]))

mcmc_plot(prior_checks_1A, type = "dens", variable = c("b_ISS_Threat")) +
    labs(x = expression(beta[k]))

mcmc_plot(prior_checks_1A, type = "dens", variable = c("b_Anxiety_Deprivation")) +
    labs(x = expression(beta[k]))

mcmc_plot(prior_checks_1A, type = "dens", variable = c("b_Depression_Deprivation")) +
    labs(x = expression(beta[k]))

mcmc_plot(prior_checks_1A, type = "dens", variable = c("b_ISS_Deprivation")) +
    labs(x = expression(beta[k]))

mcmc_plot(prior_checks_1A, type = "dens", variable = c("b_Anxiety_Unpredictability")) +
    labs(x = expression(beta[k]))

mcmc_plot(prior_checks_1A, type = "dens", variable = c("b_Depression_Unpredictability")) +
    labs(x = expression(beta[k]))

mcmc_plot(prior_checks_1A, type = "dens", variable = c("b_ISS_Unpredictability")) +
    labs(x = expression(beta[k]))

pp_check(prior_checks_1A, resp = "Anxiety", ndraws = 50) + 
  ggplot2::ggtitle("Model 1A: Prior Predictive Check (Anxiety)") +
    xlim(c(-3, 3))
pp_check(prior_checks_1A, resp = "Depression", ndraws = 50) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle("Model 1A: Prior Predictive Check (Depression)") +
    xlim(c(-3, 3))
pp_check(prior_checks_1A, resp = "ISS", ndraws = 50) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle("Model 1A: Prior Predictive Check (ISS)") +
    xlim(c(-3, 3))
```
